title: Spaç miners’ mine-site protest and work boycott
location: In front of the Spaç copper mine and Tete Albania premises, Mirditë district (source wording; exact site boundary not further established)
scope: One or more local workplace protest gatherings reported on Oct. 8–9 during a mining labor dispute; source descriptions conflict on duration and do not establish uninterrupted physical assembly.
organizer: Spaç miners and union representatives; KSSH is identified in reporting, but formal convening of the Oct. 8–9 assembly is not explicit.
participants_original: Citizens says about 70 miners boycotted work and gathered in protest on October 8 and 9. Reporter.al describes about 70 employees protesting for three days, without an exact end date.
threshold_50_evidence: Citizens’ inspected body expressly says about 70 miners gathered in protest; this points above 50 but remains an approximate report without bounds or independent contemporary corroboration.

start_date.summary: Citizens dates the mine gathering to October 8 and 9.

end_date.summary: Citizens identifies Oct. 8 and 9 while Reporter.al describes three days as of its Oct. 10 report; physical end and whether gatherings were continuous are unresolved.

location.summary: Citizens locates miners in front of the copper mine and Tete Albania premises; Reporter.al identifies the Spaç copper mine.

organizer.summary: Miners and union representatives are identified; formal assembly organizer is not specified.

demands.summary: Workplace conditions/safety, collective contract and union recognition; Reporter.al also mentions low wages.

participants_original.summary: Citizens explicitly says about 70 miners gathered in protest; Reporter.al says about 70 employees protested, but that wording alone does not establish assembly attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The reported estimate of about 70 is above 50, but its approximate nature and local turnout basis need independent review.

state_target.summary: The stated Oct. 8–9 demands are directed principally to the private mine/employer. General union calls for government action and agency mediation do not establish that this gathering itself directed demands at the state.

state_response.summary: The inspected reports establish company positions and a mediation account, but no event-specific response by state authorities to the Oct. 8–9 gathering.

notes: This is the mine-site gathering, separate from the Oct. 30 Parliament action. The approximate ~70 estimate is attached to the Oct. 8–9 gathering in Citizens; do not transfer it to other actions. ACLED’s retrospective October monthly peak does not establish individual event dates or turnout. No event-specific state response is coded.
open_questions: Was a qualifying public gathering held on both Oct. 8 and 9, and what was its physical boundary?
Can independent contemporary reporting confirm assembly attendance of at least 50?
Was the Oct. 8–9 gathering itself directed to a state authority or state policy?
What was the event end date and did a later gathering form a distinct episode?
Was there an event-specific state response?

title: Spaç miners take their labor protest to Parliament
scope: A distinct reported local protest action by Spaç miners on October 30 during the same labor dispute; not merged with the mine-site gathering.
organizer: Spaç miners; KSSH/union involvement is reported, but the exact convener of the Parliament gathering is not explicit.
participants_original: No turnout count for the October 30 Parliament action is provided.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established; Citizens gives no count for the Parliament gathering. The approximately 70 miners attributed to the Oct. 8–9 mine gathering cannot be transferred to this action.

start_date.summary: Citizens dates the action before Parliament to October 30.

location.summary: The report says the miners took the protest to Parliament in Tirana.

organizer.summary: Spaç miners are identified; KSSH was involved in the wider labor dispute.

demands.summary: Reinstatement of 17 laid-off miners, collective agreement, decent pay and safe working conditions; the report says they sought intervention from MPs and the Economy Minister.

participants_original.summary: No separate turnout estimate for October 30 is reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count for this gathering; the Oct. 8–9 mine estimate is not reused.

state_target.summary: The reported action sought MPs’ and the Economy Minister’s intervention.

state_response.summary: Seeking intervention is a demand, not evidence of a response; none is established.

notes: The Oct. 30 Parliament action is a separate location/date from the mine-gate action, although both relate to the same reported dispute. Search-result leads from held publishers are not used.
open_questions: Can an independent source establish attendance of at least 50 at Parliament?
What were the action’s end time and physical duration?
Did any state authority respond to the requests during or after the gathering?
Did subsequent activity continue the same dispute, and was it an uninterrupted physical episode?
